releaseNotes: 1.0.12: Security (#5554): a site that pins its own tenant (account or accountToken set before myContext) no longer lets ?accounttoken=, ?token= or ?account= in the URL replace it, which since 1.0.6 let a shared link render another tenant's content on a customer domain and made unrelated ?token= links (login verify, device confirm) break api calls. Hosts that pin a default tenant but serve others by URL opt in with AppSettings:acceptQueryAccountToken=true (views, DemoApplications) or apiConnector.acceptQueryAccountToken. Hosts that pin nothing (iframes, accounts) are unchanged. 1.0.11: The outage page is one file on the CDN (https://cdn.net3000.ca/themes/platform/outage.html), fetched with a 3-second timeout and cached for an hour, so its copy can change without a release; the same file is embedded as the fallback. The card is centred vertically. ApiOutage.UnavailableHtml is replaced by PageHtml() / FallbackHtml. 1.0.10: Api outage handling for customer sites (#5554). ApiOutageFilter (register once) serves a 503 page with Retry-After when the api is down instead of a 500; apiConnector.ApiUnavailable and ServiceUnavailablePage(); a call that gets no response now throws ApiUnavailableException (was a nested AggregateException) and resets LastHttpStatusCode to 0; api requests time out after 30 seconds instead of 100. 1.0.9: Preserve a public tenant selector on shared sign-in/sign-up redirects as well as returnUrl (#5299), so fresh Business Directory sessions select the right account; SignUpUrlFromAuthQuery / SignInUrlFromAuthQuery keep the auth page's own tenant on the sign-in/sign-up cross-links. 1.0.8: Account suspension rendering for customer SSR sites (issue #3029 Part 3). postForm and apiConnector expose LastHttpStatusCode; AccountSuspension detects HTTP 503 / notActive (401) and renders the platform page with Retry-After and Cache-Control no-store; FetchSuspensionHtml pulls copy from GET /common/suspension with a hardcoded fallback. 1.0.7: Move AccountAreaPage, AccountClientPortalAttribute, and AccountPublicAuthAttribute into apiConnectorCore so customer sites have shared /account/* portal defaults without code duplication. 1.0.6: getRequest / getRequest<T> never return null when the API body is empty or JSON null — keep a seeded invalid apiResponse (success=false) so callers that touch response.success do not 500. 1.0.5: Error-reporting hardening + one-line wiring.
